US Poster Telling 'Mr. Singh' to 'Self-Deport' Sparks Racism Row

A poster displayed by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) featuring the phrase 'Get off our roads, Mr. Singh' has ignited a controversy, with critics labeling it as racist and indicative of a 'self-deport' message. The poster, which also includes the text 'You don't know how to drive,' has drawn widespread condemnation. While the DHS has not issued a formal statement regarding the poster's intent or removal, the incident has fueled accusations of xenophobia and racial insensitivity within U.S. immigration policy discussions.
